description: The route-edit 9e67317b has been flagged as broken due to the closure predicate indicating that the federation-transport-vessel is active for more than 10 minutes without a valid relay, a non-empty discovery endpoint under a foreign Host header, and an unreachable HUB_DISCOVERY_URL does not continue the transport process.
goal_text: The route-edit 9e67317b has been flagged as broken due to the closure predicate indicating that the federation-transport-vessel is active for more than 10 minutes without a valid relay, a non-empty discovery endpoint under a foreign Host header, and an unreachable HUB_DISCOVERY_URL does not continue the transport process.
